title: Startup guard releases resources at most once
statement: The API startup guard cleans up only for an exception raised before the lifespan hands off (mark_started); after hand-off the normal shutdown path owns the resources, and that path releases the job reporter and storage even when orchestrator shutdown raises.
failure_mode: An error during normal shutdown re-ran startup cleanup, shutting the orchestrator down and closing storage twice and burying the original error; a failing orchestrator shutdown leaked the job reporter and storage connection.
